referencePolicy: For each new correction, only its matching Ada v2 idle image is an identity, costume and orientation reference. No other character/style references were used.
calibrationMethod: Measure the alpha>=128 body bounding box. DisplaySize = 56 * image height / body-bounds height. In the final 5% of the body-bounds height, compute each x-column’s lowest alpha>=128 pixel; origin X and Y are the medians of those lower-contour coordinates normalized by image width/height (Y uses the pixel center +0.5). This preserves Ada’s existing sole-median anchor method.
